problems.quote: The students using TRIZ-C were given access to the https://www.triz40.com/ site and were asked to not use any LLM-based AI assistants.
problems.note: The control arm was explicitly supplied a non-AI aid: the TRIZ contradiction matrix through triz40.com. Codebook Section 5 defines ai_vs_active as AI assistance versus another aid, whereas ai_vs_bau requires a comparison without assistance. Both arms following the TRIZ framework does not make this aided control unassisted. ai_vs_active is the codebook classification supported by the printed procedure, not a code printed in the paper.

summary: Read the complete 334-line markdown conversion, including the references; the PDF has no appendix. Checked the sole retained estimate against PDF p. 6 and its design, scoring, and intervention against PDF pp. 4-5; checked the other reported outcomes on PDF p. 7. F(1, 108) = 3.21, p = .076, and the design-quality counts of 63, 51, and 114 are all printed and belong to the retained full-sample Method analysis. The parenthesized counts of 62 and 113 concern student satisfaction and were correctly not used. The script-reported quotation problem is a PDF text-layer encoding artifact: replacing U+0001 with + and collapsing whitespace makes the complete recorded Table 2 quote match exactly. It is not a missing or incorrect quotation. One comparison-type coding error is reported. The remaining requested estimate classifications are supported. The pooled Table 2 means and SDs are descriptive arm summaries, not adjusted arm levels for the retained two-way ANOVA Method effect. No additional in-scope outcome or distinct full-sample contrast was identified: problem-specific simple effects and the interaction are subgroup/moderation results, survey measures are self-reports, task time is a process measure, and separate design-quality component results are not reported.
